##### Project general facts

Ayaan Heights I by Invest Group Overseas is a design-led mixed-use development. Thoughtfully crafted to integrate work, living, and lagoon-front wellness into one effortless daily flow, this visionary project creates a lifestyle of balance and intention. Every element, from its architecture to its amenities, is crafted to help residents live, work, and breathe in one seamless flow, offering enduring value for residents and sustained returns for discerning investors.

The development offers an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities designed to promote wellness, connection, and convenience at every turn. Residents can enjoy a podium-level infinity pool surrounded by lush greenery, a fully equipped fitness gym, and tranquil walking trails with scenic lagoon views. The elegant residential lobby, multipurpose rooms for events or gatherings, on-site retail outlets, and 24/7 concierge and security services create a truly integrated living experience.

Each residence features premium finishes and open layouts with serene lagoon-facing views, crafted for comfort, calm, and contemporary living. The thoughtfully designed apartments embrace waterfront wellness as a lifestyle, inviting residents to slow down, breathe, and recharge. Smart building technology enhances everyday living, creating a seamless blend of style, functionality, and modern convenience.

##### Location description and benefits

This prestigious development is situated in Meydan Horizon, a visionary mixed-use development set in the heart of Dubai that blends residential, commercial, and lifestyle spaces across an expansive landscape. The area's standout feature is a crystal-clear recreational lagoon that offers a fresh take on urban living and creates a serene waterfront lifestyle. The location provides excellent connectivity to major expressways and landmarks, ensuring convenient access to key destinations throughout the city.

The neighborhood offers a thoughtfully planned environment where work, home, and wellness come together effortlessly. The community features curated retail spaces just steps from home and office, offering everyday convenience for residents. The area's integrated design creates a harmonious balance of residential tranquility and urban accessibility.

The strategic positioning ensures seamless connectivity to Dubai's most iconic destinations, including major business districts and cultural landmarks. The location's waterfront wellness concept invites residents to slow down, breathe, and recharge in a serene setting. This distinguished area represents the perfect combination of visionary masterplanning, lifestyle integration, and investment potential, offering an unmatched living experience in one of Dubai's most exciting new communities.
